description.en: Fill a cheque correctly - amount in words, date and crossing.
description.ta: காசோலையைச் சரியாக நிரப்ப - தொகை எழுத்தில், தேதி, கிராசிங்.
description.hi: चेक सही भरें - राशि शब्दों में, तारीख और क्रॉसिंग।
description.or: ଚେକ୍ ଠିକ୍ ଭାବେ ଭରନ୍ତୁ - ଶବ୍ଦରେ ରାଶି, ତାରିଖ ଓ କ୍ରସିଂ।

submit_note: Write with one pen, don't overwrite, draw a line after the name and after the amount in words, and sign exactly as in the bank's records.

question.en: Who are you paying? Give the name exactly as on their bank account.

fields.explain: The person or company receiving the money. For a company, use its exact registered name, or the bank will return the cheque.

question.en: How much is the cheque for?

fields.explain: The amount in figures. We'll write the words for you.

question.en: What date should be on the cheque? (say 'today' for today)

fields.explain: A cheque can be deposited for 3 months from this date. After that it becomes 'stale' and the bank won't pay it.

question.en: Should it go only into the payee's bank account? (recommended - say yes)

fields.explain: 'A/c Payee' crossing means two parallel lines at the top-left corner with 'A/c Payee' written between them. The money can then only go into the payee's account, so a lost cheque can't be cashed by someone else.

documents: A pen (use the same pen for the whole cheque)
